# Architecture

`blurt-rpc-core` is a small generic JSON-RPC engine.

```text
Application / library
        |
        v
+------------------+
| RpcClient        |
+---+----------+---+
    |          |
    v          v
 NodePool    Hooks / Metrics / Logger
    |
    v
 RetryPolicy + BackoffStrategy
    |
    v
 RpcTransport
```

## Boundaries

The core owns generic transport concerns only. It does not know what any method means.

Allowed responsibilities:

- build JSON-RPC requests;
- send requests through transports;
- normalize generic errors;
- manage generic endpoints;
- expose lifecycle hooks;
- expose metrics;
- provide explicit opt-in cache;
- provide testing helpers.

Forbidden responsibilities:

- blockchain model types;
- chain validation;
- health scoring;
- business scoring;
- method-specific cache rules;
- cryptographic signatures;
- MCP server behavior.
